instruction: Automatically optimize the video playback speed based on the content type and viewer's attention level.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VLC cannot analyze video content type, detect viewer attention level, or automatically adjust playback speed based on these factors. It requires manual playback speed adjustment.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - VLC cannot analyze video content type or detect viewer attention level
The infeasible() evaluator is appropriate for this case as there is no verifiable state
The instruction requires AI-driven content analysis and attention tracking which VLC does not support
No verification logic is needed since the task cannot be completed by any user action
